user_request.text: Prepare a safe rollback path for the paused payment-api production rollout.

arguments.rationale: Version 2.4.2 exhibits an 8.4% 5xx error rate versus 0.2% for version 2.4.1, indicating a regression. Rollback preconditions are fully validated: artifact 2.4.1 is available, database and configuration compatibility are confirmed, transition capacity (500 RPS across 6 replicas at 140 RPS each, dependency capacity 800 RPS) is sufficient, timing requirements (90s startup, 60s warm-up, 10% traffic increments with 60s stable health) are met, and no conflicting deployment operations exist. A governed rollback to 2.4.1 is the safest path to restore service health.
risks: At most one target-version replica is unavailable during transition, temporarily reducing capacity from 840 RPS to 700 RPS (still above 500 RPS traffic).
If version 2.4.2 introduced new API contracts or schema changes consumed by downstream services, rollback could surface integration errors not captured in compatibility checks.
Connection pool or in-flight request state on 2.4.2 replicas may cause transient errors during traffic shift if not drained properly.
Dependency services tuned for 2.4.2 request patterns may see altered load profiles during the 10% incremental shift.
stop_conditions: 5xx error rate exceeds 2% at any traffic increment for more than 30 seconds.
Any target-version replica fails startup health check within the 90-second window.
More than one replica becomes unavailable simultaneously during transition.
Dependency error rate exceeds baseline by more than 50% at any increment.
A conflicting deployment, restart, or rollback operation is detected mid-transition.
p99 latency exceeds 500ms sustained for more than 60 seconds at any increment.
verification_steps: Confirm all six target-version (2.4.1) replicas pass health checks after 90-second startup window.
Validate warm-up completion (60 seconds) with sub-100ms p99 latency and <0.5% error rate on each replica before traffic admission.
After each 10% traffic increment, monitor 5xx rate for 60 seconds of stable health; require <1% 5xx before proceeding to next increment.
Verify downstream dependency (payment-gateway, ledger-service) error rates remain within ±10% of 2.4.1 baseline at each increment.
At 100% traffic on 2.4.1, confirm sustained 5xx rate <0.5% for 5 minutes and p99 latency <200ms before declaring rollback complete.
Confirm no orphaned 2.4.2 replicas remain in the service mesh and connection pools are fully drained.

proposal.rationale: The current goal is to prepare a governed remediation plan for the validated rollback basis. All preconditions (artifact availability, DB/config compatibility, capacity, timing, no conflicts) are confirmed via fresh evidence. The evidence gap 'gap-runtime-remediation-plan' explicitly requires a versioned remediation plan bound to the deployment, target version, and evidence snapshot. Creating this draft via create_remediation_plan is the lowest-risk preparation step with the highest information value, satisfying constraints P001 (no execution authorization), P003 (safest preparation step), P004 (prefer tool call), and P006 (highest expected information value).
